item.title: Solving construction’s landfill problem
item.description: Digital platforms are transforming the industry’s approach to surplus material. With the April landfill tax increase looming, now is the time to get smart about waste, writes Fraser Linaker of MukAway. The post Solving construction’s landfill problem appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: PAG secures Gateway 2 nod for One Cathedral Square
item.description: The path is now clear for the 27-storey residential tower, the centrepiece of Property Alliance Group’s development of the Renaissance site off Manchester’s Deansgate. The post PAG secures Gateway 2 nod for One Cathedral Square appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Performing arts college inks 8,000 sq ft Liverpool move
item.description: Rare Studio has signed a deal to occupy part of the second and third floors at Urban Splash’s Vanilla Factory, consolidating its estate. The post Performing arts college inks 8,000 sq ft Liverpool move appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Bury to progress plans for 6,250 homes on former Green Belt
item.description: A combined 1,000 acres at Elton Reservoir, Walshaw, and Simister Bowlee are allocated for residential development in the Places for Everyone joint spatial plan for Greater Manchester. The post Bury to progress plans for 6,250 homes on former Green Belt appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Flood concerns scupper Breck’s Alsager hopes
item.description: Plans for 42 affordable homes off Close Lane have been ditched by a hefty majority verdict, with questions over outfall from the site at the heart of the matter. The post Flood concerns scupper Breck’s Alsager hopes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Amazon takes 116,500 sq ft in Rochdale
item.description: The online retail superpower has agreed a lease for Cabot 116 within Kingsway Business Park, according to market sources. The post Amazon takes 116,500 sq ft in Rochdale appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: £40m earmarked to cut emissions across Liverpool City Region’s civic estate
item.description: The Cunard Building and Bootle Leisure Centre are among the 35 buildings that will benefit from a slug of the funding, aimed at reducing the carbon footprints of the publicly owned assets. The post £40m earmarked to cut emissions across Liverpool City Region’s civic estate appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: How Fettlers is becoming a turning point for Wigan
item.description: Every town has its turning point, a project or a moment that redefines its future, writes Aidan Thatcher of Wigan Council. For Wigan, that moment is unfolding now in the heart of the town centre with Fettlers: a £135m regeneration project transforming the former Galleries shopping centre into a new neighbourhood. The post How Fettlers is becoming a turning point for Wigan appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: B8RE reports bumper year for industrial investment
item.description: Marking a 16% increase on 2024, transactions totalling £1.19bn were completed in 2025, while the occupational big-box market saw a third straight year of growth. The post B8RE reports bumper year for industrial investment appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Veteran Mallinder to leave Savills
item.description: The consultancy has confirmed that director Pete Mallinder will be leaving the business at the end of March 2026. The post Veteran Mallinder to leave Savills appeared first on Place North West.
